newsitem.title: USA: Yugoslavia 97/98 wheat output to rise - US attache.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslavia 97/98 wheat output to rise - US attache.

text.p: Yugoslavia is expected to produce about 2.5 million tonnes of wheat for 1997-98, up some 40 percent from the previous year because of a large increase in planting, according to a U.S. attache report made public on Monday.

Yugoslavia imported about 125,000 tonnes of wheat in April, for a total of 255,000 tonnes imported to date during 1996/97, the report said. The report prepared by the U.S. Embassy in Sofia, Belgrade also estimated that about 45,000 tonnes of wheat would be imported during May and June.
Yugoslavia's wheat production is estimated at 5.4 million tonnes, up 2 percent from the previous year, the report said.
